### Template acceptance checks

- [ ] The package remains under solutions/license-renewal-expansion and the portable source resolves to the expected tool.
- [ ] Every advertised operation has one uploadable skill and one locked persona-language capture case.
- [ ] The approved one-pager filename and source hash remain pinned in the one-pager map.
- [ ] Every exact value is identified as synthetic or as a planning assumption rather than a measured customer outcome.
- [ ] No CRM write, outreach, approval, pricing change, forecast change, task, alert, document delivery, or customer communication occurs.
- [ ] Publishing remains a separate user-approved step after push and validation.

Source: [catalog acceptance contract](../../../solutions/catalog.json).
